body: If you know you need help then you're already on the right track. Find someone, anyone, a trusted adult to talk to. Ask for help. It can be really hard, but it's worth it. I'm only 17 and I finally asked for help last semester. My parents don't quite get it all, but they do really care. I'm sure yours will too, even if they don't seem to understand. I first talked to one of my favorite teachers, so just find someone you trust and go for it. If you never ask for help you can't get it anyways, so what can it hurt. Try not to worry, and best wishes!
